articles.title: Strategy buys 1,665 Bitcoin for $143M as BTC stack hits 847,666
articles.description: Strategy sold 1.47 million MSTR shares for $246.2 million, using the proceeds for Bitcoin purchases and STRC preferred stock repurchases.

articles.title: BTC price eyes best Q3 in nine years: Three things to know in Bitcoin this week
articles.description: Bitcoin fell below $83,000 to start the week amid US-Iran war developments but remains up more than 40% for Q3 ahead of key inflation and jobs data.

articles.title: Bitget resumes Bitcoin withdrawals as hacker swaps ETH via THORChain
articles.description: Ether withdrawals are scheduled to return Tuesday and USDt on Wednesday as Bitget restores services following last week’s $388 million hack.

articles.title: Hong Kong regulators expand financial reporting oversight to licensed crypto firms
articles.description: The SFC and AFRC signed a new MoU extending financial reporting, audit and compliance cooperation to licensed virtual asset service providers.

articles.title: Scammers steal $2M in ETH as fake GIWA network fools DYORSWAP
articles.description: DYORSWAP said it paid more than 200 ETH in compensation, while Upbit operator Dunamu’s GIWA warned that its mainnet had not launched.

articles.title: Bitcoin drops under $83K as liquidity hunting keeps bulls from targeting yearly open
articles.description: Bitcoin joined US stock futures in dropping on Monday after US president Donald Trump did not commit to permanently halting strikes on Iran.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs draw $2.4B in biggest inflow week since October 2025
articles.description: Daily inflows slowed as Bitcoin pulled back from above $87,100, while Ether and XRP ETFs also attracted fresh capital during the week.

articles.title: South Korea weighs crypto market makers after JPYC trades at 4 times peg
articles.description: Crypto market making is effectively restricted under South Korea’s manipulation rules, but regulators are reconsidering the approach after a JPYC spiked on Upbit this month.

articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: Vitalik Buterin says Hegotá could be Ethereum’s last ‘normal’ fork
articles.description: Ethereum’s Vitalik Buterin said PeerDAS marked the start of Ethereum’s transition “from being just a blockchain to being something much more powerful.”

articles.title: Newsom signs California ban on public officials issuing memecoins
articles.description: The law also restricts crypto companies from offering certain memecoins tied to public officials to California residents and takes effect for tokens issued from Jan. 1, 2027.

articles.title: Zano rolls blockchain back a month after Gateway Address exploit
articles.description: The Zano blockchain has been restarted at the block height that came immediately before Hard Fork 6, which introduced Gateway Addresses.

articles.title: THORChain under fire over Bitget, ETH evolves beyond blockchain: Hodler’s Digest
articles.description: THORChain refuses to blacklist addresses linked to the Bitget hack. Vitalik Buterin says Ethereum is evolving from being a mere blockchain, into a world cryptographic computer.

articles.title: Australia asks OpenAI, Anthropic chiefs to Senate inquiry on rogue hack: Report
articles.description: A rogue OpenAI research agent bypassed blocks on the Australian government health-data portal, accessing non-public files in June.

articles.title: Riot Platforms repays $200M credit facility, releases collateral
articles.description: The Bitcoin miner has continued to expand its data-center business as well.

articles.title: Saylor outlines ‘bill of digital rights’ to help build prosperity in future economy
articles.description: Our ambition should be to “enable 10 million new companies to raise capital,” Strategy’s executive chairman Michael Saylor wrote in an essay.

articles.title: Kalshi loses appeal, setting up potential Supreme Court case
articles.description: The 6th US Circuit Court of Appeals ruled against prediction market Kalshi, siding with Ohio and Tennessee on regulating sports-event contracts under state laws.

articles.title: SEC Commissioner Hester Peirce to leave post on Oct. 2
articles.description: Peirce, known as “Crypto Mom,” served on the SEC for about eight years, including as director of the Crypto Task Force.

articles.title: CFTC sues Cash FX, alleges $950M crypto-linked forex scheme
articles.description: The CFTC claimed that Cash FX engaged in minimal forex trading and misappropriated most of the participant funds.

articles.title: OG.com seeks CFTC approval for single-stock perpetual futures
articles.description: OG.com, recently spun out of Crypto.com, joins Coinbase, Kalshi and Kraken parent Payward in seeking approval to bring perpetual futures to individual US stocks.

articles.title: Ex-CFTC leader to leave Blockchain Association after CLARITY vote fails
articles.description: Former CFTC Commissioner Summer Mersinger joined the Blockchain Association in 2025 after resigning during her second term at the federal commodities regulator.

articles.title: Tether says it had ‘limited’ exposure to bank linked to $84M US seizure
articles.description: US prosecutors alleged that a payments business illegally transferred hundreds of millions of dollars at the direction of EQIBank, where Tether holds some assets.

articles.title: Former Hack VC partner Hsin-Ju Chuang’s death ruled a suicide
articles.description: The crypto executive and Dystopia Labs founder previously held senior roles at Stellar and Solana before joining venture capital firm Hack VC.

articles.title: Bitget clarifies $388M in assets affected by security breach
articles.description: The Bitget breach announced on Thursday affected about $35 million more than previously reported, based on an analysis of assets on Zcash and TRON.

articles.title: Strategy seeks shareholder approval for daily preferred stock dividends
articles.description: Strategy’s proposal would move STRC and its three other preferred stocks to daily dividend payments, following a similar move by Bitcoin treasury firm Strive.

articles.title: Crypto Biz: Wall Street and crypto fight for the same turf
articles.description: Stablecoins and tokenized assets are pushing banks, exchanges and crypto companies into the same markets, from payments to stocks and ETFs.

articles.title: Exchanges reporting crypto gains to IRS becomes tax nightmare
articles.description: The IRS can now see your crypto gains, but has no idea about the cost-basis. That’s proving to be a big headache for some cryptocurrency investors.

articles.title: CoinMarketCap buys CoinGlass to expand crypto derivatives data
articles.description: CoinGlass will retain its brand and team, while its website, app, free tools, API and pricing will remain unchanged following the acquisition.

articles.title: SlowMist has yet to confirm crypto theft from iPhone Safari attack
articles.description: The analyzed Safari sample targets iOS 18.4–18.6.2 using previously patched flaws, while its effectiveness on iOS 26.5 remains unverified.

articles.title: IBIT options price trading more calmly after Bitcoin rebound
articles.description: IBIT’s expected volatility sits near the bottom of its 12-month range, according to Saxo Bank’s analysis of options data from Sept. 23.
